relation_rows: p20023.seed.result.json accepted_rows plus p20023.result.json rows; retain a row iff every referenced column survives
subset_law: keep the anchored generator column; order every other original column by SHA-256 of ASCII 'hecke-shift-density/v1:' plus seed label plus ':' plus decimal original column index; take the first table_size-1
shift_rule: for each retained projected point Q, include Q+G when the hit also survives; verify the point identity; contract connected shift components with log offset +1 modulo 4021
rank_rule: reduce every retained Hecke row to shift-component variables, append anchored log(G)=1, and compute exact GF(4021) rank; unresolved component dimension equals component count minus rank
validation: independently reconstruct all projected edges and retained rows and compare component rank with a separate Sage GF(4021) matrix rank
